title: WeekStrip
description: The seven days of a week in a row: select a day, see today at a glance, mark days that have tasks, and step through weeks.

support.notes: Shared local-date core: the seven days of a week from firstDayOfWeek; controlled/default string selection (v-model) and Date week (v-model:week, follows the selection while uncontrolled); today override, count/dot markers with localized accessible names, getDayLabel, previous/next week navigation with a localized month heading, weekday labels, size and disabled; listbox/option semantics with arrow, Home/End and PageUp/PageDown keys across weeks. Keyboard metadata and native touch actions are implemented; device focus/geometry still require validation. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

api.notes: Shared local-date core: the seven days of a week from firstDayOfWeek; controlled/default string selection (v-model) and Date week (v-model:week, follows the selection while uncontrolled); today override, count/dot markers with localized accessible names, getDayLabel, previous/next week navigation with a localized month heading, weekday labels, size and disabled; listbox/option semantics with arrow, Home/End and PageUp/PageDown keys across weeks. Keyboard metadata and native touch actions are implemented; device focus/geometry still require validation. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: WeekStrip
translationResources.description: The seven days of a week in a row: select a day, see today at a glance, mark days that have tasks, and step through weeks.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A controlled selected day ("YYYY-MM-DD"). Today is ringed and carries aria-current="date"; the strip is a horizontal listbox operable with the arrow keys, Home / End and PageUp / PageDown.

markers.title: Markers
markers.description: markers maps a day to a number (a count badge, 99+ above 99) or true (a dot). firstDayOfWeek picks the first column; getDayLabel customizes the accessible names.

navigation.title: Week navigation
navigation.description: showNavigation adds previous / next week buttons and the month of the week. Control the displayed week with week / onWeekChange; arrow keys also cross into the neighbouring weeks.

sizes.title: Sizes and disabled
sizes.description: Three densities (counts become dots in the small size), and a disabled strip.

WeekStripProps.week: Displayed week (controlled; any day of the week; pair with onWeekChange)
WeekStripProps.defaultWeek: Initially displayed week (uncontrolled; any day of the week); an uncontrolled week follows the selected day
WeekStripProps.onWeekChange: Called with the first day of the requested week, at local midnight
WeekStripProps.firstDayOfWeek: First day of the week: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday ... 6 = Saturday
WeekStripProps.today: The day marked as today, "YYYY-MM-DD" (e.g. a server date or a fixed date in tests)
WeekStripProps.markers: Per-day markers keyed by "YYYY-MM-DD": a number shows a count badge (99+ above 99), true shows a dot
WeekStripProps.getDayLabel: Accessible label of a day; receives the day ("YYYY-MM-DD") and its marker
WeekStripProps.showNavigation: Shows previous / next week buttons around the month of the week
WeekStripProps.weekdayLabels: Weekday names, Monday first (7 labels), whatever firstDayOfWeek is
WeekStripProps.aria-label: Accessible label of the day list

cssVars.--week-strip-weekday-color: Text color of the weekday names
cssVars.--week-strip-marker-color: Text color of the count badge (and color of the dot)
cssVars.--week-strip-nav-height: Size of the previous / next week buttons (defaults to the density's small control height)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: value ("YYYY-MM-DD") is an attribute; minerva-change reports the selected day. One tab stop: the arrow keys, Home / End and PageUp / PageDown move through the days.

markers.title: Markers
markers.description: markers is a property mapping a day to a number (a count badge, 99+ above 99) or true (a dot). first-day-of-week picks the first column; the getDayLabel property customizes the accessible names.

navigation.title: Week navigation
navigation.description: show-navigation adds previous / next week buttons and the month of the week; minerva-week-change reports the first day of the displayed week, also when the arrow keys cross into another week.

sizes.title: Sizes and disabled
sizes.description: Three densities (counts become dots with size="small"; also the :state(size-small) ... custom states), and a disabled strip.

events.minerva-change: The user selected a day (detail: { value }, "YYYY-MM-DD").
events.minerva-week-change: The user displayed another week (detail: { week }, its first day at local midnight).
